lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Anand says she called out Russian counterpart invited by U.S. to G20 ministerial, The Canadian Press reports.
Canada, European Union close Montreal summit with ‘alliance for the future’ pact, CP24 reports.
The federal government has listed the Port of Vancouver’s planned Roberts Bank Terminal 2 expansion as a project of national interest, The Canadian Press reports.

Some Backstreet Boys fans attending one of the group’s Toronto shows aren’t happy with their seat change after Live Nation relocated fans who unknowingly bought tickets that had an obstructed view, CBC News reports.
Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots as criminal probe underway over Senate candidate, The Associated Press reports.
Binance and its billionaire founder have long been accused of profiting off crypto criminals, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
